title: THE WORST DESIGN EVER
text: THE WORST DESIGN EVER. I had gotten the Ninja blender and it worked great for a while. I really liked - past tense - the locking lid, but cleaning it by throwing it in the dishwasher or washing it by hand was futile.  I had been using my blender for many months when I started noticing a rotten smell that was nauseating. After a little thought, I figured out the milk that I was using to make smoothies and milkshakes was collecting within the inside of the lid. I almost threw it out and got a new lid. Instead, I decided to try and fix it, which ended up being a real pain in the neck. I had to take the lid apart, piece by piece, and wash every piece in there that were covered in dry old milk residue. I had to do this for DAYS before I was able to *mostly* get the rotten smell out. (Note that I said MOSTLY). I put it back together and attached the fixed lid onto the pitcher. I was able to lock it without a problem, but I haven't used it since I did that. It's functional, but I don't want to have to go through that again, since this will inevitably happen again.
